test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 96 is divided into two parts in such a way that a seventh part of the first and a ninth part of the second are equal. Find the larger part.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of the parts is the inverse of their fractions: **Part 1 × (1/7) = Part 2 × (1/9)**.

⇒ **Part 1 : Part 2 = 7 : 9**.

Total units = 7 + 9 = 16 units → 96.

1 unit = 96 ÷ 16 = 6.

Larger part (9 units) = 9 × 6 = 54.

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total sum = 96. Let the first part be **x** and the second part be **y**.

**Formula Used:** Sum of parts = x + y; Given condition: x/7 = y/9.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b05734fd8613ad69ba7af8e0804ae8bff838b234adabe391e452d1ef3b0461c.png] 

⇒ x + y = 96

⇒ x/7 = y/9 ⇒ x = 7y/9

⇒ 7y/9 + y = 96

⇒ (7y + 9y)/9 = 96

⇒ 16y/9 = 96

⇒ 16y = 96 × 9

⇒ y = 6 × 9 = 54

⇒ x = 96 − 54 = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

If a/b = c/d, then the parts are in the ratio of their denominators when the numerators are equal.

Inverse Ratios

If m × A = n × B, then the ratio A : B is equal to n : m.</p
